name: Get workflow meta information
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current user's workflow capabilities, feature flags, and related metadata for automation. Use an action that modifies settings (e.g., automation.update_workflow_settings) if you need to change any of these values instead.

items.description: Privilege that the user has for workflows (e.g., activate, settings, crud).

privileges.description: List of workflow privileges granted to the user.

is_ent_or_agency.description: Indicates if the account is an enterprise or agency account.

is_ma_db_created.description: Indicates whether the Marketing Automation database has been created.

language.description: Preferred language of the user (e.g., en).

user_info.description: Basic information about the current user.

is_premium.description: Indicates if the account has a premium plan.

is_classic_user_active.description: Whether the classic user mode is active.

is_classic_editor_hidden.description: Whether the classic editor UI is hidden.

is_user_on_classic_editor.description: Whether the user is currently using the classic editor.

is_bispa_enabled.description: Whether BISPA (Business Integration Service for Product Automation) is enabled.

is_preview_trigger_events_enabled.description: Whether preview of trigger events is enabled.

is_bis_restock_minimum_enabled.description: Flag for BIS restock minimum feature.

is_fue_vert_account_enabled.description: Whether the FUE vertical account feature is enabled.

items.description: Name of a pure object source (e.g., product).

pure_object_source.description: List of pure object sources available.

is_user_on_v5.description: Indicates if the user is on version 5 of the workflow editor.
